info.title: DocuSeal CCN API (fork additions)
info.description: Operations the CCN fork adds to DocuSeal's API (docs/openapi.json documents the upstream ones, all implemented). Administration functions that are UI-only in DocuSeal (users, webhooks, account settings, template folders, template versions, field detection) plus the `preferences` extension of PUT /templates/{id}. Same authentication as upstream (X-Auth-Token). Every refused request answers 422 {"error": "..."}.

put.description: Upstream's operation (name, folder_name, roles, archived) extended with `preferences`: the per-template preferences of Settings → Preferences (e-mail subjects and bodies, completed_redirect_url, default_expire_at, 2FA requirements, submitters_order, bcc_completed, completed_message, link_form_fields). A null value removes a key; an unknown key is a 422. Read them back with GET /templates/{id}.
